title: PDP / buybox - Quantity discount
summary: A volume discount display component showing tiered pricing benefits based on purchase quantity with auto-generated discount tier labels.
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Quantity Discount component displays volume discount tiers to encourage bulk purchases by showing customers the savings available at different quantity thresholds. It motivates larger orders by clearly communicating progressive discount benefits.

## Use Cases

- Displaying volume discount tiers for bulk purchases
- Showing progressive savings percentages at quantity thresholds
- Auto-generating tier labels based on quantity breakpoints
- Supporting flexible discount structures per product or category

## Design Rationale

The component automatically sorts and formats discount tiers to ensure consistent presentation regardless of input data order. Auto-generated labels reduce configuration complexity while maintaining clear communication. The visual design emphasizes savings percentages to draw attention to the value proposition. Support for unlimited discount levels accommodates various B2B and B2C pricing strategies.
